title: Siege of Xàtiva (1707)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Xàtiva (1707)", at revision 1374999321, opens: "The Siege of Xàtiva was a siege of Xàtiva in the Kingdom of Valencia. It took place between 8 May and 6 June 1707 during the War of the Spanish Succession." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3486057, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle in Xàtiva (1707)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
